sti_consumables_explainer: Sa lash'gen achadon chovai tak consumables raliethai. Healing Lotus acha vo' henshui tak vu reason, but Greater Healing Lotus ne other combined versions acha (combining ish initiates a purchase event). It acha possible tak abuse sa doq initiating multiple purchase events ne selling vu rast (e.g. rage mass buying nereyikoshai), sa icha affect vu pochov chov doq raliethai.
